messages:
harper: Quick sync — I'm cleaning up the compact min/max card when min == max. Usability test showed people think it's an error. Need better affordance and copy. maria: Good call. Users expect a clear label: not an error, but an intentional lock. Suggest header: 'Capacity locked' and a one-liner explaining who locked it (policy vs user). aj: Also callout: the same UI appears in Dedicated and Hosted. We must standardize strings across both. No 'Enable burst' on pools that don't support it. harper: Current placeholder CTA is 'Enable burst' which is wrong for many pools. Proposal: primary = 'Enable autoscaling', secondary = 'Edit min/max'. If pool.supportsBurst == false, primary should be visible but disabled with a reason. priya: Implementation note: prefer aria-disabled + aria-describedby rather than entirely hiding the CTA. Backend exposes pool.supportsBurst and pool.lockedBy. Tooltip must be keyboard-focusable and dismissible with Esc. sam: Accessibility: add an sr-only summary for the whole card so screen readers read: 'Capacity locked. Autoscaling disabled. Min and max equal N GPUs.' Also ensure badge contrast meets 4.5:1 in dark mode. harper: For the disabled CTA example snippet: ```html
Autoscaling unavailable: this pool does not support burst
``` maria: Copy nit: prefer 'Enable autoscaling' (verb) and always spell 'autoscaling' the same in strings. I'll update the central strings doc. Also add small muted cost hint: 'Est. +$0.14/hr' when data available, and hide it for private installs if policy forbids. aj: Flow-wise: clicking primary should open an inline confirmation bar (not a full modal) that behaves like a dialog for a11y: role=\"dialog\", focus trap, aria-live announcement. Confirm text: 'Enable autoscaling? Pool size may vary between A and B GPUs.' Buttons: Confirm / Cancel. priya: We have InlineConfirm component that does this. We'll reuse and add an announce string param. For disabled state, we'll return the tooltip text as a tabbable element. Example: tabindex=0 on tooltip. sam: Also add a micro-warning when SLO slider is set aggressive and pool is locked: 'Selected SLO may need more reserved capacity. Consider enabling autoscaling or increasing min.' Add 'Learn more' link to docs. The pill should be non-blocking and keyboard-focusable. harper: UX question: should the pool dropdown show SLO preview when pool is locked? I lean to showing a greyed preview with a tooltip: 'SLO preview unavailable for locked pools'. That avoids hiding info entirely. maria: Agreed. Provide textual fallback like 'p95 X ms, Est +$Y/hr' for screen readers and small graphs should have alt text. aj: One more: when user confirms enabling autoscaling, run a lightweight simulation and show immediate feedback: 'Projected p95 improves to Xms; est cost +$Y/hr.' If simulation isn't allowed for private, show a simple toast 'Autoscaling enabled'. priya: Note: simulation requires canSimulate flag. If false, skip sim and show baseline toast. We'll return simScoreText when canSimulate is false so frontend can show something instead of graph. sam: Accessibility checklist (for ticket): sr-only card summary, tabbable tooltip, tooltip closable with Esc, inline confirm uses role=\"dialog\" + focus trap + aria-live, badge contrast, graph alt text. I'll add to QA steps. harper: Thanks. Action items: Maria updates strings and Figma frames, Priya wires supportsBurst/lockedBy/canSimulate + reuses InlineConfirm, AJ verifies the simulation UX for hosted vs dedicated, Sam writes accessibility QA. I'll attach a preview when Figma is ready. accessibility-bot: preview published: https://preview.redwood.design/branch/minmax-locked-ux — includes keyboard walkthrough and dark-mode checks. harper: Great. I'll update the ticket with final copy and acceptance criteria. Thanks team!
